title: How to Fix the Issue of Linking the Wrong HoYoverse Account
summary:
Dear Proxies,

We've received feedback today that, when logging in via Steam, some users accidentally used a third-party account's email to create a new HoYoverse account and link it to Steam, resulting in their inability to log in to their original game account or unlink it on their own.

If you have encountered this issue, you can resolve it using the following method:

1. Go to: https://cs.hoyoverse.com/new-csc-new-os-account-retrieve-fe/index.html?channel_id=212&token=12b45097-ba0f-4854-a278-226f81c5037e#/

2. In the HoYoverse Account Issues Application form, select "I need to unlink my (one/several) third-party account(s)," then select Steam as the third-party platform and enter the corresponding Steam account name (optional).

3. Enter the email address we can use to contact you in the "New Email Address" field.

4. In the "Please enter your game account UID" field, enter the UID associated with the incorrectly linked HoYoverse account (i.e., the UID displayed in the bottom-right corner of the game after logging in to the incorrectly linked account via Steam).

5. If your appeal is approved, launch the game again via Steam. On the "Link HoYoverse Account" page, use the QR code login method to link your original third-party account. When scanning the QR code on a mobile device, tap "More Login Options" and log in to your HoYoverse account via third-party login.

Note: Logging in by directly entering your username/email may result in linking the HoYoverse account that was accidentally created during the linking process again.

*If you have any questions about the instructions above, or if your unbinding appeal was not approved, please contact our customer support team, and include your in-game UID, server region, platform, a description of your issue, and any relevant screenshots.

Customer Service Email:

https://zzz_cs@hoyoverse.com

From gazing up at the sky to measuring its depths.

When approaching a target that can be charged, a connection prompt will appear. When approaching a target that can be destroyed, the object will display a special visual indicator. Proxies can activate the drone's skills by following the on-screen guidance.

After Proxies activates the Singularity Leakage, the surroundings, objects, and enemies in the area will change. Proxies can directly eliminate the Singularity Leakage itself by using Pyrois' abilities to escape.

▶ Shiyu Defense
After the Version 3.0 update, the buff effects of Critical Node are as follows:
Phase I:
• Agent Wind DMG and Ice DMG increase by 30%, Vortex DMG increases by 30%. After an Agent uses an EX Special Attack, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40 for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

• Agent Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate and Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate increase by 25%. When Agents inflict an Attribute Anomaly on enemies, their DEF is reduced by 10%, and they take 20% more Attribute Anomaly DMG for 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

Phase II:
• Agent Wind DMG and Ice DMG increase by 10%. When hitting enemies afflicted with an Attribute Anomaly, Agent ATK increases by 15% and ignores 10% of their All-Attribute RES.
• Agent's Ultimate and Chain Attack DMG increase by 40%. When Chain Attack hits an enemy, the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 20% and their Daze recovery slows down by 15%, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
• Agent ATK increases by 30%, CRIT DMG increases by 15%. Enemy Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 20%.

Phase III:
• Agent's Chain Attack and Ultimate DMG increase by 40%. When Chain Attack hits an enemy, the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 20% and their Daze recovery slows down by 15%, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
• Agent's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 20, and Anomaly DMG dealt increases by 10%. When there are 1/2 Agents with the Anomaly specialty in the squad, Agents ignore 5%/15% of the enemy's All-DMG RES.
• Agent's Ice DMG increases by 30%. Agent's Basic Attack and Chain Attack DMG increase by 20%, and CRIT DMG increases by 35%.

Phase II:
Girtablullu, Primordial Nightmare - "The Creator", Ye Shiyuan the Thrall

Phase III:
Phaethon of the Scorched Horizon, Notorious - Pompey, Miasmic Fiend Unfathomable

※ The end time for Deadly Assault in Version 3.0 Phase III has been adjusted from 2026/07/31 03:59 (server time) to 2026/07/29 03:59 (server time). Proxies, please complete your battles in a timely manner.

▶ Hollow Zero

• Adds Tactical Prism Programs for Agents Velina, Norma, and Pyrois, along with the corresponding Task Force Missions. (Norma's Tactical Prism Program will be made available at the same time as the Agent's Exclusive Channel.)

Adjustments & Optimizations
▶ Agents

The note stating that Mindscape effects can trigger at most once every 180 seconds in Investigation Zone Mode has been moved to the Mindscape Cinema interface text. This adjustment only affects text placement and has no impact on the actual Mindscape effects.

▶ Systems

• Optimizes global illumination and distant model details on PC. Devices equipped with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 Series or above (with RT Core units and at least 8GB VRAM) now support Ray Tracing. Additionally, Frame Generation and Super Resolution based on DLSS/FSR3 have been added.

▶ Others
• Optimizes some performance formats.
• Optimizes the model performance for NPCs Remielle and Velina.
• Optimizes English, Japanese, and Korean voice-overs for story scenes and combat sequences of previous versions.

Issue Fixes
▶ Agents & Enemies
• Fixes an issue where the enemy Phaethon of the Scorched Horizon would take abnormal Vortex DMG after activating the Gale Scorcher state under certain circumstances.
• Fixes an issue where Agent Evelyn experiences abnormal Burning Tether Point recovery under certain circumstances.
• Fixes an issue with the text description of Agent Cissia's Mindscape 04: A Rogue's Resolve in the Mindscape Cinema interface, aligning it with the text displayed in the in-combat Mindscape Cinema interface. This adjustment is purely textual and does not affect the actual skill effects.
Before: Each stack consumed triggers 1 instance of Corrode Bone that does not consume Venom
Fixed: Each stack consumed triggers 1 special instance of Corrode Bone that does not consume Venom

▶ Systems

• Fixes an issue where certain "new" indicators would not properly clear under certain circumstances.

▶ Music & SFX

▶ Others

title: Zenless Zone Zero Steam Version Launches June 17
summary:
Zenless Zone Zero officially launches on Steam on June 17!
Steam Preload for Zenless Zone Zero Is Now Available:
https://hoyo.link/qqMvGg8Me
The Steam version will be cross-compatible with existing mobile, PC, PS5, and Xbox platforms. Version 3.0 content will also be available at launch!

▼ Add to Wishlist
https://hoyo.link/qqMvGg8Me

▌ Launch Details
Launch Date: After the Version 3.0 update on 2026/06/17
Supported Servers: Europe, America, Asia, and TW/HK/MO servers

▌ System Requirements
Recommended Specifications: 10th Gen Intel Core i7, 8GB RAM, Nvidia GeForce GTX1660 or better
Minimum Specs: 7th Gen Intel Core i5, 8GB RAM, Nvidia GeForce GTX970 or better
System Requirements: Windows 10 64-bit or later, DirectX 11.1 or later
Storage Requirements: 75GB of available space required

▌ FAQ

※Account-Related
Q: How do I link my Steam account with my HoYoverse account?
A: When logging into Zenless Zone Zero via Steam for the first time, Proxies will need to link their Steam account with their HoYoverse ID. You can follow the in-game guidance and complete the account linking process using one of the following two methods.
Option 1: If you have already created a HoYoverse ID, we recommend using that to log in. When you launch Zenless Zone Zero for the first time on Steam, select "Login with existing HoYoverse ID," and then link up your existing HoYoverse ID with your Steam account as per the prompts.
Option 2: Use your Steam account to create a new HoYoverse ID. When you launch Zenless Zone Zero for the first time on Steam, select "Create HoYoverse ID now" to log in to the game.

Q: If I link an existing HoYoverse account, will the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero inherit my progress from other platforms?
A: Yes, your progress will carry over. This Steam advance test uses the official version of Zenless Zone Zero. If the HoYoverse account you link already has an existing Zenless Zone Zero game account, your progress will transfer to the Steam version once the link is complete. Since the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero supports America, Europe, Asia, and TW/HK/MO servers, Proxies should confirm after linking that they've selected the correct server where their existing progress is stored.

Q: I selected [Create HoYoverse ID now] when logging into the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero for the first time. Can I use this account to continue playing on other platforms?
A: Yes. If you created a new account on the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero and wish to play Zenless Zone Zero on other platforms, please ensure that your HoYoverse account has an email address linked to it. If no email is linked, you can complete the linking process in the User Center webpage. Once linked, you can log in on other platforms using your email address.

Q: How do I unlink my Steam account from my HoYoverse account?
A: You can log in to the User Center webpage and complete the unlinking process on the linked accounts page by following the guide. Please note that before unlinking, you must ensure that the HoYoverse account linked to that Steam account has an email address linked to it, otherwise unlinking will not be possible.
User Center URL: https://account.hoyoverse.com/

※ Payment Related
Q: Can I make in-game purchases normally when playing Zenless Zone Zero on Steam? (Such as purchasing Monochromes, Inter-Knot Membership, New Eridu City Fund, etc.)
A: You can make purchases normally. The in-game items available for purchase are the same as on the other platform clients. You can simply follow the guide within the client to complete your purchase.

Q: Can I use items from top-ups on other platforms or Steam (such as Monochromes, Inter-Knot Memberships, etc.) across different platforms?
A: You can, once you've linked your accounts. When switching platforms, all items received from top-ups will be displayed and can be used normally.

Q: I registered a new game account on the Steam version. Can I make purchases for account on other platforms?
A: You can make purchases on any platform. ※ Please note: If you select "Create HoYoverse ID now" when first logging in to the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero, you will create a new game character on Steam.

※ Other Issues
Q: Does the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero support pre-downloading new version updates via the HoYoPlay launcher before the update goes live?
A: The Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero does not currently support pre-downloading new versions of the game via the HoYoPlay launcher. After server maintenance begins for each update, Proxies can head to their Steam library to download and install the latest version of the game.

Q: Can the game's Resource Management function be used in the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero?
A: Apologies, but the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero does not currently support the Resource Management function. When playing the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero, the full game assets will be downloaded and installed by default for all Proxies, and resource deletion is not available.

Season 3's brand-new city, Roscaelifer, will be revealed in full for the first time!

This program will also take you deeper into this Celestial Nexus — uncovering its unique culture and all the fresh new gameplay waiting for you!

In addition to the latest information on new Agents Velina, Norma, and Pyrois, the Chief Welfare Officer is here to unveil some surprise gifts just for you!

We will also be dropping an exclusive redemption code during the livestream, so make sure you tune in on time. Don't miss out, Proxies!
